description: She wears an opaque dark russet-burgundy floor-length gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Broad gold-patterned woven borders run down the front and along the neckline, sleeve cuffs and hem. A cream underdress appears through the lower front opening. A purple-brown shawl with gold patterned edging and fringe rests around her forearms. Two round gold-toned shoulder brooches and a decorated belt with a round clasp are visible, along with small earrings and rings. Brown closed shoes with gold-toned motifs show beneath the skirt.
